Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 1489/2023

Dear Ms. Hegde,

Thank you for meeting us on 14/07/2023 about your dispute with Shalini Rao. As we understand it, both spouses have lived apart for a long time.

Our advice is to apply to waive the statutory cooling-off period. Please collect proof of separate residence and the consent terms and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹22,20,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
